english:
<stasis Stasis /> Weapon hits applied non-simultaneously within 3 seconds grant a stack of <stasis Frost Armor />. Hits during the 0.5 second cooldown do not count, and the counter resets on stow.

Instances required:
• Bows: 3
• Breech Grenade Launchers and Swords: 2
• Magazine-based weapons: 35% of the Magazine plus 2, rounded down

This does not require a <stasis Stasis /> Weapon to be readied; the current weapon's Magazine is used instead.

Scoring the same instances on <stasis Slowed /> enemies also spawns a <stasis Stasis Shard /> on top of them.

Instances required on Slowed enemies:
• Bows: 3
• Breech Grenade Launchers and Swords: 2
• Magazine-based weapons: 25% of the Magazine plus 2, rounded down

source.text:
Upon scoring multiple non-simultaneous Stasis Weapon Damage instances within 3 seconds of each:
Grants a stack of Frost Armor.
Incurs a 0.5s cooldown between triggers. Additional hits during this time do not count.
Counter resets on stow.

Instances to trigger Frost Armor:
Bows: 3 | Breech GL, Swords: 2
(35% of Magazine, rounded down) +2
Doesn't require a Stasis Weapon to be readied, instead using the current weapon's magazine for calculations.

Upon scoring multiple Stasis Weapon Damage instances within 3 seconds of each on Slowed Enemies:
Bows: 3 | Breech GLs, Swords: 2
(25% of Magazine, rounded down) +2
Spawns a Stasis Shard on top of the enemy.
